original_description: Explore tattoo ideas by theme, style, placement, and size. Compare available visual references with their sources and reuse limits, or generate an original concept from your own brief. Every plugin workflow works without an account or sign-in. A guest session is created automatically for private generation and retrieval, lasts seven days, and is subject to service limits. Refine a completed concept while preserving earlier versions. View the real artwork in ChatGPT and use its returned continuation link to preview or download it in the browser without signing in. The continuation page also provides the Tatty app download route. Generated images are digital concepts for discussion with a tattoo artist, not finished tattoos, guaranteed tattooable artwork, or ready-made stencils. Catalog coverage varies; references may be inspiration only. The plugin does not book artists, diagnose tattoo health concerns, accept body photos, or publish your private designs.
summary_ja: タトゥーの参考例を探し、オリジナルのデザイン案を作成・修正する。
limitations: ゲストセッションは7日間で利用制限がある。生成物は施術可能な図案や型紙を保証しない。
実動作・料金・一覧本体との照合は未検証。
